name: Breakdown fix finder
summary: Takes a machine breakdown from the business's job system to a fix: it logs each open breakdown, drafts a fault-finding note from the same customer's earlier jobs and the parts on hand, escalates a breakdown that stays open past the window, and writes the repair record when the job completes. Crons read and draft; an escalation email waits for a person to approve it.

covered_by.make-safe: skill (safety procedure stays with the site)
covered_by.source-parts: diagnose (parts on hand listed in the note)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Open breakdown jobs in the job system become fault records.

crons.name: diagnose
crons.summary: Draft a fault-finding note from the customer's earlier jobs and the parts on hand.

crons.name: escalate
crons.summary: Queue an escalation email for a breakdown still open past the window.

crons.name: record
crons.summary: Draft the repair record on a completed breakdown job.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a note on a job in the job system. The escalation email reaches a person outside the crew, so it is a live operation and waits for approval.

servicem8.covers: breakdown jobs in a set status, the same customer's earlier jobs and their notes, parts on hand, the fault note, the escalation email, the repair record from parts used

gaps: MEX Maintenance (mex-cmms) is the closest fit to this job, but the kit has no mex-cmms platform and no mapped operations. Its help pages describe work requests and inventory, not a fault-diagnosis flow.
MRPeasy: its help pages describe no breakdown or repair workflow, and the kit has no mrpeasy platform.
Odoo: the kit maps one read (a version check), so its maintenance module is not mapped.
AroFlo: the kit maps its task and quote operations, but its signer is not built (auth type unsupported), so nothing can be called yet. Its docs are pages, not a schema.
Lockout and isolation: no mapped platform holds the procedure. The note reminds the crew to make the machine safe first; the site's own procedure governs.
Fault diagnosis and the return-to-production sign-off are judgment steps at the machine. The drafted note lists history and parts only; it does not name a cause.
Breakdown status name: ServiceM8 status names are set per business. settings.breakdown_status must match the client's own name for an open breakdown.
Job-to-asset link: the mapped ServiceM8 operations hold no job-to-asset field, so the note matches history by customer, not by machine.
Parts ordering from suppliers is not automated. The repair record lists the parts used on the job only.
ServiceM8 is spec status and tested offline only; no live account has run these operations.
